comments_text: Amolopin can stimulate insulin release in INS-1 cells in a dose-dependent manner, thereby of interest for type 2 diabetes (T2D). The original incomplete 43 kDa bacteriocin was replaced. Updated 6/2020
reference_text: Nat Prod Bioprospect. 2014 Oct;4(5):309-13. doi: 10.1007/s13659-014-0037-z. PubMed.
title: A Novel Insulinotropic Peptide from the Skin Secretions of Amolops loloensis Frog.
